balls.text: caught behind as Holder sticks to his plan - targeting the wide line - and Maxwell slogs wildly, getting a bottom edge through to the keeper. Appropriate finish from a bowling side that's been superb tonight.
searches for a wide yorker, and he gets penalised for it. Saha and Holder are bemused and they have a right to be because Maxwell walked so far across off stump.
walks across his stumps again and whip-pulls it off his hips to the long leg boundary. Rashid misfields allowing a second

good bowling! When a batsman is camped deep in their crease, bowl wide outside off, and take a bit of pace off. Especially if he's Maxi. With that wide open stance. Oh crap. It's a wide. It's only inches wide

that's massssssiiiiiveeee! At this stage of the innings, batsmen know what's coming. The yorker. So they set up deep in their crease. AB does it. Hardik does it. Maxwell does it. And here he gets a full toss for his trouble which he wallops over deep midwicket
plants that back leg across to open up the leg side, but the slower bounce wanders away too far down leg

launches it over to deep square leg and comes back for the second. That brings up his first IPL fifty in five years. Typical hit to bring up the landmark as he moves across in his crease and takes a near yorker almost all the way
backs away and whacks it one-bounce to long-on. He doesn't take the single.

taken at long-on. Jamieson is backing away. Holder follows him. The plan is to go yorker. It's not the perfect one, which is why the ball goes in the air, but it's close enough to that blockhole that the batsman just can't get enough leverage. Top stuff from Sunrisers.
Maxwell dashes out of the crease, converts what would've been a yorker into a full-toss, and swipes it over square leg
another yorker from Natarajan, threatening the stumps and tailing away late to dip under the bat. Warner likes it.
Trick shot from Maxwell! He knows Natarajan is searching for the wide yorker. He flips into a left-hander and scoops it over short third man for four. Reverse-scooped away
back of a length and outside off, Jamieson throws his bat at ball and plinks it to long-off
full and wide of off, Jamieson reaches out for the ball and scythes it away to the left of long-off
Natarajan nails an off-stump yorker, dug out through midwicket
slower ball, 127ks, short on off, fended back to the bowler. A frustrated Bhuvneshwar under-arms it back onto the stumps
Bhuvneshwar searches for the off-stump yorker, comes out as a low full-toss. Jamieson clears his front leg and belts it in the air to the right of the bowler
back of a length and wobbling into middle. Probably a cutter, whipped through midwicket
full-toss on off, Maxwell clears his front leg and smites it away between deep midwicket and wide long-on
full-toss, bending in to catch the thigh pad and roll to cover. This seems to be sliding down leg
crunnnnnnnnnched! Back of a length and outside off, Jamieson uses his reach and pumps it between extra-cover and long-off
Natarajan misses the yorker, but it's still a decent low full-toss, stabbed down to long-off. Excellent over from Natarajan
yorker, tails in a wee bit, Jamieson digs it out

Saha belts out an appeal for caught behind. Given out by umpire Gandhe. Christian chats with Maxwell and calls for a review. Very full and very wide of off, Christian reaches out. He throws his bat at ball. He did he nick it? Ultra Edge detects a spike, so umpire Gandhe's decision is upheld. First wicket this match for Natarajan as RCB continue to stumble
back of a length and outside off, possibly a slower ball from Natarajan, pulled away to deep midwicket off the back foot
just short of a yorker, chipped in the air to the left of Natarajan
yorker (what else?) right at the base of off stump, dug out through midwicket
back of a length and fizzes in on middle, Maxwell goes back and hauls a pull to deep midwicket. Another top spell from Rashid: 4-0-18-2

Pandey runs in from long-off, dives forward, and completes another sharp catch. Warner called for more energy in the field - his boys are responding to him. Much fuller and Rashid takes this across from Washington. He aims to slog-sweep this wrong'un against the turn, but ends up splicing it to Pandey who is a spectacular fielder too
back-of-a-length wrong'un, this time to Maxwell, clipped through midwicket
speared on middle, Washi backs away outside leg, manufactures swinging room and lashes it to deep cover
wrong'un, on a length and spinning away, knocked to point with an open bat-face
yorker-length slider on middle, squirted back to Rashid
punched down to long-off

Washi shows his ace early, jumps so far across off and searches for the scoop. Bhuvneshwar takes pace off with an offcutter. Scooped behind. Saha dives across to his right, and almost pulls off a one-hander. The ball pops out in the end
hard-length delivery on middle and leg, cramps Washington, stabbed off the inner half to midwicket
full and sliding into off and middle, poked into the covers
shorter and wide of off, forced away to the right of mid-off
check-driven over Holder at mid-off. Slower variation from Kumar, full and wobbles away outside off. Washi drives and chips it over Holder
another wrong'un, even fuller and spinning away, sliced to deep cover
rips past the outside edge. Sharp wrong'un, Washi plays for the legbreak and is beaten on the outside edge. That'll keep Holder interested at slip

Rashid comes back and takes out AB. Kohli and AB fall in successive overs. Shortish legbreak, comes off so very slow, Rashid takes it away from the swinging arc of the batsman. AB throws his bat at a cut and slashes it to Warner at extra-cover
short and skidding in at middle, might have been a googly which is stabbed past the right of Rashid
low full-toss outside off, muscled away to sweeper cover
full on off, no real turn either way, whipped to deep midwicket
another bouncer from wide of the crease, tennis-ball bounce, 121ks, AB thinks about another ramp but belatedly shelves the stroke
slower bouncer outside off, AB looks to ramp it to third man. No dice
back of a length on off, run away, Warner swoops down on the ball from backward point and keeps it to a dot
Maxwell rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and steers it to deep third man
back of a length and just a shade outside off, played back to Holder

Excellent catch in the outfield from Vijay Shankar in his 100th T20. Banged in short on middle, hip-high delivery on middle, not all that short, not all that quick, but the ball isn't coming on, messing with the pull. Spliced into the night sky off a top edge. Vijay sprints in from long leg and snaffles it. He's a fine fielder - has pulled off some blinders as a sub for SRH in the past. Slides on his knees and snaffles it
mighty full on middle, whipped to Rashid at deep midwicket. Take him on at your own peril. Good, tight over from Nat
Natarajan knows Kohli is trying to line him up. He sends a wide yorker, or rather a wide full-toss. Kohli stretches out, swishes and misses
shortish on middle, Maxwell hangs back and nurdles it through square leg
full on middle and leg, knocked away through midwicket
well bowled, Natarajan! He knows Kohli will jump out of the crease, he drags his length back again and rolls out a whippy offcutter to beat the outside edge
lifter outside off, left alone, wide called for height
Kohli steps out to Nat once again, he drags it short and takes pace off. Kohli drags a pull behind square
short and flat on middle, shovelled to wide long-on with the bottom wrist. 22 off that over
tossed up on off, Nadeem bowls it full, Kohli meets it early by stepping out. Dumped over Nadeem's head
low full-toss on off, stabbed down the ground
Nadeem keeps dragging it shorter, this is aimed at middle. Maxwell goes deeper in the crease again and crunches another pull over midwicket. Another six. Woof, that gum-chewing nonchalance from Maxi
rifled through the covers! Dragged down once again, the line is wider of off. Maxwell reaches out for it and smacks it through the off side
back of a length, and angling into middle from around the stumps. Maxwell jumps back and pummels a pull over midwicket. Bam!
Rashid finds grip and turn, sending this legbreak past Kohli's lousy waft in the channel. Good finish to the over
on a length and breaking away outside off, solidly punched to sweeper cover
Kohli gets inside the line and works a googly towards fine leg
attacking the pads, deflected behind square on the leg side
short, wide, spinning away, nice defensive ball with sweeper in the deep. Slashed straight to him
darted on off, short of the slot, so Maxwell can't get underneath the length. Heaved to long-on
fast and flat on the hips, whipped through midwicket
Maxwell brings out the reverse-swat, drags it to cover
Nadeem slows it up, gets it to drift in from outside off and just bounce over off stump as Maxwell chops and misses
shortish and outside off, slashed to cover, where Warner, I think, makes a half-save
Kohli presses forward and knocks this middle-stump delivery to long-on
dropped short and spins away outside off, Maxwell uses the depth of the crease and smears it away to wide long-off
slider from Rashid, 93ks, not short enough for the pull. Off the thigh pad and pops up into Saha's gloves
hauled away through square leg off the inside half as Rashid rushes the batsman into his stroke
wrong'un, on a back of a length and fizzing into off, kept out
shorter and speared outside off, chopped to point off the back foot
legbreak, tossed up slower and higher, spinning away outside off. Maxwell goes after it and ends up carving the ball over extra-cover. One-bounce four
looks like a fast wrong'un that is fired down the leg side, wide
lobs a full-toss outside off, carved away to the left of Samad at sweeper cover
Nadeem gets more turn, sliced to short third man
back of a length, drifting in towards off, and spinning away fairly sharply to beat the outside edge
arm ball from Nadeem, fizzes in, takes the leading edge and plops to the covers
Maxwell chops this off-stump length ball to point
on a length and spinning away outside off, forced off the back foot through the covers. Point runs across and slides to gather the ball

Terrific catch from Rashid Khan. He tears across to his right from deep square leg, slides on his knees, and takes out the pinch-hitter. Ahmed had the license to go after the bowler. He shimmies out of the crease and aims to line-up the left-arm fingerspinner, but drags it away to the leg side. Rashid makes the catch look so very easy. Ahmed can't clear the bigger side of the ground
slower-ball offcutter from Natarajan, 121.5ks, Kohli reads the change-up and defensively drops the ball to cover
darted on middle, but the length is so very full. Kohli picks it up, twirls his wrists, and dismisses the ball to the midwicket boundary
mighty full on leg stump, not quite the perfect yorker, jabbed away through square leg. Vijay Shankar hunts the ball down in the outfield
Kohli shimmies out to Natarajan once again, the left-arm seamer bangs it shorter on the body, turned away to the right of midwicket
Kohli dashes out to Natarajan first ball and heaves it away to the right of deep square leg for four
back of a length and on the thigh pad, Ahmed lines up for a swat, but doesn't get enough bat on ball. Off the pad and rolls to leg side
dinked through vacant midwicket. Ahmed and Kohli scamper across for the single
punched to Holder at wide mid-on
Ahmed shuffles across off once again, this time he forces a single in front of square, through midwicket
Ahmed shuffles across off, puts Nadeem off, dragged down the leg side. The batsman drops down to one knee and shovels it over short fine leg
flat and quick on middle, Kohli hangs back and whips it with the wrists through midwicket
on a length and the new-ish ball slides on outside off, chopped to cover-point off the back foot
slower short ball, 105ks, slanting into off, Kohli hops and flaps it away to short fine leg. One of those variations that has made Holder a better limited-overs bowler
back of a length on middle, Ahmed gives himself a bit of room and check-drives it over mid-off. Warner chases hard and keeps it to three
short and angling across the left-handed Ahmed. He leans back, ramps, and misses
short again, but not as short as the last ball, fended off, a fumble at short fine leg allows Kohli to get off strike
oooooh, top ball from Big Jase. He runs in hard, hits the deck harder and gets it to sail into the gloves of Saha. Kohli aims for a pull/hook, but it gets big on him and angles down the leg side
back of a length and running away outside off with the angle, tip and run to point. Kohli coaxes Ahmed into an urgent single
short on leg stump, dinked down to fine leg

hauled to midwicket! Sharp catch from Nadeem. Padikkal throws his head back and walks off into the dug out. Back of a length and around off, not enough room for Padikkal to have a free swing, he finds the infielder
bumper down the leg side, wide called for height
back of a length and skidding into the pads, Padikkal hangs back and doesn't meet with the leg-side flick
Padikkal steps out of the crease, and hacks a middle-stump ball to midwicket. Will Saha come up to the stumps?
down the track, Bhuvneshwar sees it, so pulls his length back and finds some movement away from the advancing batsman. An outside edge streaks down to third man
Padikkal shimmies out and jabs an urgent single to mid-on. He takes on Shahbaz Nadeem's arm for the single
dug in shorter at the body, seam-up stuff, glanced through square leg
short again, this is wide of off. Padikkal loves it there. This seems like the cutter too. Padikkal delays the cut and cracks it over point
Signs of ring rust from Holder. He shoves another short ball down the leg side
Padikkal dashes out of the crease. Holder drags his length back outside off, swish and a miss
better line and length from Holder. He hits an in-between length and gets it to angle across off, dabbed fine of Bairstow at short third man. He makes a tumbling save to his right
short and sliding down the leg side once again, diverted away only as far as Saha behind the stumps
...but he starts off with a loose delivery floating down the leg side, Padikkal gets up on his tippy toes and glances it away just wide of short fine leg for four
starts on leg stump and nips away sharply, some extra bounce to boot. Padikkal is up to the challenge although he's opened up a bit. He steers it away to deep third man
much fuller and aiming for middle stump, Padikkal's confident front-foot push intervenes
on a length and angling away just a shade outside off, blocked on the back foot
no swing again. So Kohli dares to step out to Kumar and dabs this shorter delivery outside off to deep third man
pumped straight of mid-off! Bhuvneshwar pitches it up further, searches for swing, but it isn't there, Kohli plants his front leg and hits over the top
nice and full, slanting in with the angle from over the wicket, defended on off stump. No real movement in the air or off the seam
back of a length and outside off, another slower ball, hauled away to deep midwicket

Ahmed is in the thick of the action. He runs back from backward point and snaffles it. Offcutter into the pitch. Nadeem makes room outside leg, Patel chases him with that variation and has him holing out

another slower short ball dug into the pitch, hauled away to deep square leg. Rashid has to come back for the second....and he's caught well short. Good, flat throw from Siraj at deep square. Looks like it'll be nothing for SRH. Replays indicate that was a short run as well. Rashid didn't drag his bat past the line at the bowler's end
well bowled, Patel 119.4ks, cutter into the pitch. Rashid swings too early and does not make contact
high full-toss on middle, beamer over the waist. On-pace delivery, surprises Rashid who slugs it over backward square despite falling on the floor
full-toss on off, swiped to deep midwicket for the double. That should've been put away
wide yorker, dug out to short fine leg off the inner half. Rashid gets the strike
Rashid venture down the track. Siraj darts a wide full-toss away from the reach of Rashid
dug in short on middle, this on-pace delivery is dragged between deep midwicket and wide long-on
offcutter, back of a length and outside off, swiped away wide long-on off the inside half
Holder picks out long-off. Fullish ball outside off, possibly a slower variation again. Holder prefers hitting down the ground, he ends up slicing a loft to long-off
slower ball, hard length into the pitch, 113ks, carved in the air, but does carry to short third man. Offcutter from Siraj
scythed over point. Struck flat and hard - timely six for SRH. On-pace shortish ball outside off, Rashid manufactures more swinging room and cracks it hard

holes out to Kohli running in at deep midwicket. 113.9ks slower-ball offcutter outside off, deceives Vijay. He picks it up in the air and hits it straight to the RCB captain. SRH are making a mess of this chase
inch-perfect yorker just outside off, squirted to short third man
full-toss on middle, below the waist, this free-hit is spliced in front of long-on. Holder tears back for the second. SRH need boundaries. These singles and doubles won't do
full-toss down the leg side, beamer, called a no-ball
shortish and outside off, Vijay looks to dab it away between short third man and backward point. Slices it more or less straight to backward point
back of a length and wide of off, chopped to point. They need to hare across for the single. A direct hit could've had Vijay
really full on off, Vijay hangs back and taps it down to long-on

Triple-wicket over from Ahmed! He takes this return catch and wheels away. Catch him if you can. Sliding into middle, hint of extra bounce, Samad aims to bash it over the leg side with a slog-sweep. Instead, he skews it back to the bowler. He holds his nerve and pouches it
fired on a length on middle, Samad plays it back to Ahmed
darted into middle and leg, worked through midwicket
arm ball, sliding into off, defended

two in two for Ahmed. The pressure gets to Pandey and he holes out this time. He dashes out of the crease for the punch over extra-cover. Ahmed held this back and gets it to spin away from the advancing batsman. This sliced hit settles into the hands of Patel at short third man

AB calls for it and takes this skier near the midwicket region after tumbling into the turf. Flat and quick, sliding into middle, Bairstow aims to slog-sweep it over the leg side. Instead, he slices it high and AB does the rest with the big gloves
fractionally short on middle, slider, hauled away to wide long-on
shorter and spinning away outside off, Bairstow laces it to the left of sweeper cover off the back foot
shortish legbreak outside off, forced back to Chahal
back of a length and spinning away outside off, leans back and punches through point
wrong'un, whisked through midwicket off the back foot. They push for the second and get another thanks to an overthrow. Pandey looks fried but makes it in the end
shortish and spinning away outside off, Bairstow leans back and chops to point
full on middle and leg, knocked away towards wide long-on
back of a length and angling into middle, turned to the right of midwicket
the pressure gets to Pandey. He gets away with it. Tossed up liberally and spinning away outside off. Down the track and sliced over cover, drops wide of long-off
flat and quick on off, tip and run to cover
full and sliding into middle, played back to Ahmed
arm ball outside off, draws a skittish chop to slip
beats Washington to his right at deep midwicket. Dug in short on middle, hip-high ball, Bairstow swivels on the back foot and nails a pull to the right of the outfielder
on a length and angling into off, Bairstow closes the bat-face and turns it to midwicket
back of a length and outside off, Bairstow flashes a drive down to mid-on
back of a length and nipping down the leg side, tickled away fine of long leg

Jamieson takes pace off it and takes it away from Warner's swinging arc. Offcutter, grips in the pitch. Warner has to fetch the pull from outside off. He can only drag it straighter than intended to long-on. Warner exits, exposing SRH's suspect middle order
slower ball outside off, short, Warner aims a pull, goes for the shot too early and almost plays on
hip-high short ball outside off, another slower offcutter, heaved across the line to deep midwicket
slower, short ball outside off, Warner swishes too early and misses
hip-high short ball on middle, pulled flat and hard to deep square on the bounce
offcutter, short and outside off, dabbed to short third man
slower, shortish and outside off, heaved away so straight it hits the stumps at the other end. They take two off the ricochet

slower ball, short, and wide of off. Laced wide of sweeper cover. Jamieson collects the ball and throws it flat and hard to AB. A full-length dive saves Warner. He brings up a half-century with a hard-run double
full and wide of off, squirted through cover-point region. Just two runs off the over
dipping full-toss on leg stump, whipped to Chahal at deep square leg. Four dots followed by a single
Pandey shimmies out and yorks himself. Jammed back to Patel
111ks offcutter from wide of the crease, swerves in, Pandey is beaten for the lack of pace. It wasn't too far away from the stumps either
back of a length and sliding into middle, played back to the bowler
inswinging yorker at leg stump from wide of the crease, top ball from Patel, but Pandey digs it out
might have been a wrong'un, Warner keeps it out
tossed up on middle stump, no turn either way, bunted down to long-off
flat, quick, and this googly is guided wide of short third man
darted onto the leg stump, Warner rolls out the traditional sweep. Struck flat and hard to the left of deep square leg
legbreak, dipping and turning in from outside off, squirted to the leg side via an inner edge
reverse-swept from a middle-stump line through point. Fast hands and sublime placement from Warner, beats sweeper on the off side to his right. Jamieson slides in vain in the deep
dipping full-toss on off, white-ball trickery from Patel, jabbed down to long-on
on a fuller length and outside off, guided to point
back of a length and zipping away outside off, Warner loses his balance and is beaten. He got out in a similar fashion to Krishna vs KKR. He has got out in similar fashion to Archer
on a length and slanting into off stump, bunted down to long-on
slower ball. Short, wide, cracked to backward point, where there's a fumble
utterly battered to the right of mid-off. Pitched up and outside off, offcutter, Warner manufactures his own pace and crunnnnches it down the ground
lobbed up on off, whisked away to the left of short midwicket
dipping legbreak outside off, Pandey stabs it out to the covers
starts around middle stump and spins away sharply to catch Pandey in a tangle. He is opened up as he wafts it away to the right of a diving Kohli at slip
tossed up outside off, belted through the line to wide long-off
tossed on middle and spinning away, dabbed to point with the break
flighted on off and middle, slog-swept to deep midwicket
back of a length and spinning in, Pandey shuffles back and across as he works it to midwicket with the break
on a length and spinning in sharply, inside-edged onto the pad
what a response from Pandey! Fullish and outside off, right in Pandey's slot, muscled over long-on for a massssssive six
on a length and Washington finds spin, of the quicker variety, to thump the pad of Pandey, but he seems to be hit outside off
hard-length delivery on middle, Warner gives himself some room and forces the ball down to long-off
flat and spinning into middle and leg, Pandey hangs back and tucks it down to fine leg
paddled from leg stump, but struck straight to short fine leg
on a length and spinning back in quickly, Warner camps back and works it defensively to the leg side
flatter, faster, spinning away, slashed to sweeper cover off the back foot
flighted and spins away outside off, patted to short cover off the front foot
Chahal tosses it up slower and higher, delightful legbreak, finishes just a shade outside off, draws the outside edge and goes to where slip may have been. Rolls down to the third-man fence
back of a length and running away outside off, probably a googly, dabbed to point
Chahal slides this legbreak down leg, away from the reach of the sweep, wide called
back of a length and skidding into leg stump, tucked away through square leg. SRH 50 for 1 in six overs
back of a length on leg stump, Warner clears his front leg and hauls it away over midwicket. More off the inner half, but SRH won't mind this. Back-to-back fours off Siraj
Warner leans back and chops an off-stump back-of-a-length delivery fine of deep third man, this time he finds the fence
shortish and angling away, guided fine of deep third man. Warner scampers back for the double
Pandey stays leg-side of this short ball outside off, and punches a single wide of mid-off
lifter on middle, angling in at the head, Pandey ducks out of the way. Well-directed bouncer from Siraj
hard-length delivery just a shade outside off, Warner manufactures some swinging room and lashes it straight to extra-cover. Decent first over from Washington
on a length and spins in from outside off, knocked down to long-on
back-of-a-length offbreak, fired down leg. Washi has to rebowl it
shorter on middle, nearly 100ks, but Pandey has time to jump back and pull it over the square-leg umpire
darted on the hips, chipped in the air but does not carry to square leg
Pandey steps out, speared on a back of a length on middle, clipped into the leg side
sliding across off from round the wicket, played back to him
fine leg is inside the circle. You can't bowl short and down leg, KJ. Warner swivels on the back foot and pulls it over that fielder
back of a length and skidding through, Warner hops and blocks on middle
pitched up and attached with width outside off, Warner latches onto it and drives with a slicing motion. Carved over extra-cover and wide of mid-off
shorter and outside off, Pandey angles his bat and glides a single down to deep third man
pretty full and angling into middle, right in Pandey's swinging arc. Serious whippage. Lifted over the midwicket fence with the bottom wrist. New ball, please...
back of a length and slanting in at off, pushed into the covers
much fuller and outside off, 144.5ks, Pandey nervously taps it to the left of mid-off and closes out the over
back of a length and bending in at off, 144ks, terrific bowling from Siraj, blocked back to him
bumper outside off, wide called for height. Kohli isn't pleased one bit. Gets too big on the hook
Pandey rides the bounce of this 140ks short ball outside off and plays it to point
just short of a good length and seaming in at 144.2ks, blocked back down the pitch

slashed straight to Maxwell at backward point. Short, wide outside off, Siraj gives Saha a chance to free his arms and break free. He cuts firmly but straight into the lap of that infielder. Saha v Siraj: 0 off 8 balls
hard-length delivery just outside off, prodded back to Siraj off the inner half
short, wide, Jamieson gets away with it as Warner only carts it as far as extra-cover
hip-high short ball on middle and leg, Warner swivels on the back foot and dispatches it to the left of short midwicket with a full-blooded pull
shorter and angling across off, Warner sizes up the length and width, cutting it firmly between point and cover-point. Sliding save in the outfield from Siraj
after playing out a maiden over, Saha skips out of the crease, and drags a length ball from outside off to mid-on
back-of-a-length nip-backer from Jamieson. Cramps Warner for length and room. He hops and chops an inside edge
back of a length on middle and leg, Jamieson makes Warner hop and play it back to him
full and wide of off, swings away further, off-side wide

Siraj cranks it up to 144.3ks. Nip-backer on a length, bounces over the stumps and slides away down the leg side away from the reach of a diving AB. Saha wafts and has no clue about the sharp seam movement
short and zipping back in, rushes Saha for pace, he jabs at the ball and almost plays on. The ball bounces over middle and leg
Siraj pounds it on a heavy length and gets it to skid back in, Saha hops and fends it off to point
shorter and outside off, nips away further, the new ball is swinging more under lights. Saha has a bigger swing at it, away from the body, only to miss it altogether
fuller than a good length and sliding in with the angle at off stump, prodded into the covers off the outer half
on a length and swinging away outside off at 136ks, Test-match line and length, no shot from Saha
